exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal, caesarean section after labour, elective caesarean section)
Time after birth (1-10 min, 11-20 min, 1, 2, 4, and 24 hours)
cohort: 115 healthy newborns born at ≥35 weeks gestational age
finding: In healthy transitioning newborn infants, lung aeration and partial liquid clearance are achieved within minutes after birth, with complete liquid clearance typically achieved within the first 4 hours.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in lung aeration and liquid clearance between infants delivered vaginally and those delivered via cesarean section.
